decisions.reason: It was still actively presented a year after launch and, as a standard sensor module in a modular electronics range, it likely remains worth keeping unless component supply or demand weakens.
Because it explicitly replaced an earlier generation, it looks like a core continuity product in the portfolio and is therefore relatively unlikely to be withdrawn quickly.
A CAN bus interface fits durable industrial and embedded use cases, so despite being more niche than basic I/O products it would usually be retained if it supports the system offering.
It had its own product page and addresses a clear sensing need, making it a comparatively strong candidate to stay in the catalog rather than be removed.
